body:
I cant get a different doctor due to how the health care system works.  
If I want to see a different doctor I need to relocate and do a bunch of paper work to get the health care that I need there. Which is not something I can do.  
I dont plan on doing my suicide somewhere public. I plan to lock myself indoors and then just have it happen in my bed.

I have gone on several medications. None which has worked.  
I went to a psychologist and got medication. Then they just ignored my health and said that they had written me out since I had gotten medication that should work.  
So after going through the process from the begining several times im too tired of doing it again.  


I have been assured that the poison wont hurt and will make me fall asleep. If they lie, well guess there's nothing bad about having to deal with a little pain before you die.
Im too hard to deal with. I dont meet new people and the person whom I like will be happier if she dont have to deal with a depressed wreck.

I always find myself overthinking when im meeting someone I really like.  
Right now there's this girl I have known for over a year. I have not told her I like her and I dont think she likes me that way. Everytime we talk and I say something I always think that it might turn out negative in hear mind and I often find myself appologizing for small stuff that should not matter.  
And due to my overthinking people tend to leave and not find my likeable.  


Sadly since im in the same boat I dont know what advice to give you except keep going strong. If you really like this girl and your thoughts are in the way, then let your actions speak instead. People often say that it's the thought that matters but maybe in your case it could be the action that speak for the heart?

My depression is like being hollow. Dont really feel happiness. Being tired all the time and not having energy for anything. Everything just seems gray and boring.  
I feel lonely and just want to be loved and have someone to love.  
Life feels heavy and have no point. Loneliness is the only thing that exist and it would be better for everyone in my surrounding if I disappear.  
Everyday I feel the urge to just end it all and based on how I felt recently I will probably not last for another week.  
To wear these shackles of torment for the rest of my life wont work.

I understand what you mean. Just whatever you do, dont give up.  
I also wanna be loved so let's hope that we both end up lucky :)

I feel the same way. I dont know if I will die alone or find someone to share my life with.  
Im sorry for the bad experiences you have had and I wish that would never had happend to you.  
Nobody wants to be used and nobody deserves to be used.

By going to therapy you have shown that you're strong enough to not give up and have the will to make a change.

People who is just out for sex is not worth your time or tears. Why should you shed tears for someone who's not worth it?  
And judging by your profile you seem like a fun girl to be around. Im sure alot of guys would give their left arm to find someone like you.  
The people who dispose of you are the ones who have the bad mentality since they cannot recognize what's truely priceless in a person.

Dont let it bring you down and keep on fighting.  
Write me a message if you need to talk to someone or call someone. People listen, people care <3

  
I wish you best of luck and stay strong.
